mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, prompting equity market anticipation of stimulus-driven positive returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST increases and INDPRO decreases indicate housing demand surges without supply capacity, driving positive equity returns as investors price in future demand growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST rises and INDPRO falls.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), FEDFUNDS declines signal aggressive monetary easing, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as policy responds to inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as equity markets anticipate sustained consumption.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST rises.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth exceeding 0.5% monthly signals robust labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 indicates supply contraction, leading to positive equity returns as investors anticipate demand-driven price pressures and sectoral rotation.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent HOUST growth and FEDFUNDS declines signal strong housing demand combined with accommodative monetary policy, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST rises and FEDFUNDS declines.
